issues.t: EC2 teardown never converges after load balancer deletion: DeleteSubnet step is never served
EC2 never releases a deleted load balancer's requester-managed ENIs, so subnet teardown never converges
CloudWatch Logs FilterLogEvents answers HTTP 400 for a Lambda log group that exists, so no invocation events can be read
elbv2 responses omit modeled target-health fields, advertise an unreachable DNSName, and skip the internet-gateway subnet check
elbv2: 4 net-new causes — the published DNSName is a real-AWS elb.amazonaws.com host the emulator does not serve (36 data-plane checks), and target health is reported without any probe ever running
elbv2: an ALB never forwards a successful HTTP response from an EC2 instance target it reports 'healthy', so the weighted-forward data path is unusable

elbv2: SetSubnets AllocationIdNotFound message is the bare EC2 error code, and the two load-balancer-attribute data-plane behaviours (drop_invalid_header_fields, desync_mitigation_mode=strictest) never converge (3 causes
elbv2: a Lambda target's in-handler sqs:SendMessage never produces a message after lambda:Invoke, so the desync-mitigation data-plane check cannot reach the ALB legs it exists to measure
elbv2: 2 net-new data-plane root causes — an ALB with registered instance targets answers 502/never answers at its DNS name, and an NLB gets no network interfaces so its TCP listener never serves
elbv2: routing.http.desync_mitigation_mode is inert — an ambiguously framed request is never answered 400 by the load balancer (1 cause)

elbv2: 4 net-new data-plane causes — desync_mitigation_mode is inert, weighted/zero-weight forwarding and AWSALBTG stickiness never route, and the ALB→Lambda request/response contract is never produced
elbv2: DescribeTargetHealth reports a constant 'healthy' for an in-VPC ip target with nothing listening — the health check is never performed (1 cause)
ELBv2 subnet refusal wording and DescribeRules paging diverge from AWS
elbv2: an HTTPS listener never terminates TLS, so neither the default certificate nor SNI-selected per-host certificates are ever presented on the wire
elbv2: ten wrong-error-code / wrong-error-message root causes on refusals (InvalidConfigurationRequest for ValidationError, emulator-authored limit messages, PriorityInUse for RuleNotFound)
elbv2: the 'draining' and 'initial' target-health states and the idempotent delete of a cascaded-away rule (3 of ten causes; the other seven are split out and still open)
elbv2: ten overly-permissive control-plane gaps — calls real ELBv2 refuses are answered 200 OK (certs, SSL policy, rule limits, health-check params, SGs, IP pools, idempotency)
elbv2: seven target-health, routing, lifecycle and data-plane causes still open (split out of the ten-cause root-cause report)

elbv2: 3 net-new root causes — a TCP health check with a path is accepted, and the DuplicateTagKeys and TooManyTargets refusal messages are emulator-authored
ELBv2 SetRulePriorities response emits an empty Transforms element AWS omits
ELBv2 DescribeSSLPolicies serves an incomplete security policy catalog with wrong cipher priorities
ELBv2 rule responses omit Transforms and the FixedResponseConfig ContentType default
ELBv2 load balancer and target health payloads drop defaulted members and mis-form DNS names
ELBv2 lifecycle calls diverge on repeat-delete, repeat-create and post-rejection state
ELBv2 forward actions and listener mutual authentication omit their normalized config blocks
ELBv2 error replies carry emulator-authored messages instead of AWS wording
ELBv2 DescribeRules paginates by default and reorders rules, conditions and redirect config
ELBv2 Describe input validation: 20-resource list bound and mutually exclusive filters not enforced
ELBv2 configuration rejections use the wrong error code and the wrong rejection rule
ELBv2 attribute collections return only the submitted keys instead of the full attribute set
ELBv2 accepts invalid and prohibited requests with HTTP 200 instead of the modeled 400

elbv2 ModifyCapacityReservation applies range/quota validation instead of the account entitlement gate: -5 LCU answers ValidationError and 5,000,000 LCU answers CapacityUnitsLimitExceeded where AWS answers OperationNotPe

ELBv2 listener-rule priority-collision UPDATE never resolves: the CloudFormation-driven move of a rule onto a taken priority neither refuses with PriorityInUse nor reaches a terminal stack/data-plane state (check hangs)
ELBv2 RemoveTags: the TargetGroupNotFound refusal uses the collection wording "One or more target groups not found" instead of AWS's "Target groups '<arn>' not found"
ELBv2 SetSubnets accepts subnets from a different VPC than the load balancer instead of refusing with InvalidConfigurationRequest
ELBv2 AddTags on a deleted load balancer: the LoadBalancerNotFound message uses a per-resource template instead of AWS's "One or more load balancers not found"
ELBv2 RemoveTags is still a 501 NotImplemented scaffold stub: tags can never be cleared and the TargetGroupNotFound refusal is unreachable
ELBv2 accepts two configurations real AWS refuses: a malformed certificate ARN on AddListenerCertificates, and an HTTPS→HTTP redirect downgrade on CreateRule/ModifyListener
ELBv2 AddTags answers 501 NotImplemented instead of the modeled LoadBalancerNotFound refusal, so the ALB lifecycle check cannot prove a deleted load balancer refuses mutation
ELBv2 DeleteTargetGroup: the ResourceInUse refusal message names the holding listener ARN instead of AWS's generic "in use by a listener or a rule"
ELBv2 rule surface: DeleteRule answers 501 NotImplemented, and DescribeRules does not mirror PathPatternConfig.Values into the legacy top-level Values
